name: Button
summary: An action the user takes. The one component every interface needs, and the one that has to look right in thirty-two different moods.
summaryZh: 用户触发的动作。每个界面都离不开它,也最容易在三十多套 mood 里走样。

variants.name: Primary
variants.note: The one action the screen wants.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size needs no modifier class.

props.name: variant
props.descriptionZh: 这个按钮代表哪一类动作。

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and hides the label, keeping the width.
props.descriptionZh: 显示加载指示,隐藏文字但保持宽度不变。

props.name: glow
props.description: Applies the mood's glow hook. A mood without one shows nothing.
props.descriptionZh: 应用该 mood 的发光钩子;没有定义发光的 mood 不会显示任何东西。

a11y.notes: A real <button> element, so it is focusable, activatable by keyboard and announced correctly. A disabled button uses the real disabled attribute rather than aria-disabled, so it is skipped by the tab order.
a11y.notesZh: 使用真实的 <button> 元素,可聚焦、可用键盘触发、读屏播报正确。禁用态用原生 disabled 属性而不是 aria-disabled,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: One variant per action type. The label colour on a filled button is the theme's own on-colour, derived to reach 4.5:1 against that fill.
examples.descriptionZh: 每种动作类型一个变体。实心按钮上的文字颜色是该主题自己的前景色,由主题派生保证与底色达到 4.5:1。
examples.markup:
<button class="um-button um-button--primary">Primary</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--default">Default</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--text">Text</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--success">Success</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--warning">Warning</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--danger">Danger</button>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: The medium size is the default and needs no modifier class.
examples.descriptionZh: 中号是默认尺寸,不需要修饰类。
examples.markup:
<button class="um-button um-button--primary um-button--sm">Small</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--primary">Medium</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--primary um-button--lg">Large</button>

examples.title: States
examples.description: A disabled button paints a flat surface and takes the derived disabled colour, so its label is still measurable. It is not dimmed with opacity, because opacity is not a colour and nothing about it can be checked.
examples.descriptionZh: 禁用按钮使用扁平底色和派生的禁用色,文字依然可测量。它不用 opacity 变淡 —— opacity 不是颜色,无法被校验。
examples.markup:
<button class="um-button um-button--primary" disabled>Disabled</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--default" disabled>Disabled</button>
<button class="um-button um-button--primary um-button--loading">Loading</button>

notes: The quality hook `.um-button--glow` lives in the shared hooks layer rather than in this component, because it is a mood capability and not a button variant. The loading spinner is painted in the label's own colour — the label colour lives in one variable that both read — so the spinner is always as legible as the label it replaced, on every variant and in every mood.
notesZh: 质感钩子 `.um-button--glow` 放在共享钩子层而不是组件里 —— 它是 mood 的能力,不是按钮的变体。加载指示器用的是标签自己的颜色 —— 标签颜色只存在一个变量里,两者都读它 —— 所以无论哪个变体、哪套 mood,指示器都和它替换掉的标签一样清晰。
